profile.regional_context: QTS was founded in 2003 by Chad Williams, went public via IPO in 2013, and was acquired by Blackstone (via Blackstone Infrastructure Partners and BREIT) for approximately $10 billion, completed August 31, 2021. QTS is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of QTS's Northern Virginia campus, spanning Loudoun County (Ashburn-Shellhorn, Ashburn-Moran, Ashburn Lockridge buildings), Prince William County (Manassas DC1, DC2, DC5), and Sterling (Ashburn 1, Ashburn 2). Northern Virginia is confirmed by Wikipedia as one of QTS's primary operating regions, alongside the separate Richmond, VA campus recorded elsewhere in this registry.

reading.body:
QTS Manassas is part of a planned six-building, 105-acre campus in Prince William County with a published total critical capacity of 190+ MW. This is the operator's stated campus capacity figure, not a confirmed per-building breakdown. The facility sits in Virginia, a state with 326 mapped data centers, of which 23 have published power specifications totaling 1,375 MW. This campus would rank 24th in the state by published capacity, just outside the top tier of Virginia's disclosed facilities.

The 190+ MW campus capacity translates to roughly 4,750 racks at the common AI training density of 40 kW per rack, or roughly 950 to 1,900 H100-class accelerators at typical per-unit power draw of 100 to 200 watts, assuming all capacity is allocated to compute rather than storage or network. No per-building breakdown, occupancy rate, or current utilization is published. The facility's ability to support specific workloads depends on infrastructure details not in the operator's public specification.

QTS is a major operator owned by Blackstone as of August 2021, with a Northern Virginia footprint spanning Loudoun, Prince William, and Sterling. The campus belongs to a multi-site cluster in the region, which is a known concentration point for data center investment. Whether this campus is binding for AI scaling depends on grid availability and interconnection status, which are not published here.
